display_contract.component_formula: ratio component: oriented_index_t = 100 + direction * ((value_t / value_t0) - 1) * 100; signed component: oriented_index_t = 100 + direction * ((value_t - value_t0) / historical_level_sd)
display_contract.index_formula: index_t = arithmetic mean of available oriented_index_t component values
display_contract.interpretation_rule: Derived indices are transparent comparative analytical products, not causal or predictive verdicts.
display_contract.mixed_frequency_rule: Derived composites may carry each component most recent real observation internally; source observation dates remain traceable and no synthetic source observation is written.
display_contract.nonpositive_baseline_rule: A zero or negative baseline is never ratio-rebased. A component may remain eligible only through an explicitly governed non-ratio transform in its model definition.
display_contract.ratio_eligibility_rule: Ratio rebasing is structurally invalid for a canonical series whose observed history spans zero or contains zero. Such a component may participate only when its governed definition explicitly selects the signed_level_sd transform; otherwise it is omitted and the omission is exposed.
display_contract.v1: Risk, Growth and Macro are displayed together in NOW from a common baseline of 100.
display_contract.v2: The selected index reference plus all components are displayed below V1 from a common baseline of 100.
display_contract.signed_series_rule: A governed series that structurally crosses zero uses additive movement divided by the sample standard deviation of its finite canonical historical levels. One historical level SD therefore equals one index point. The scale is computed from the same canonical evidence snapshot and persisted with the derived record.
